key_insight: A PET-aware AI registration method aligns longitudinal whole-body PSMA PET/CT scans while limiting changes to quantitative tumor measurements.
clinical_relevance: More consistent scan alignment could support longitudinal cancer imaging research and treatment-response assessment; this is an imaging method, not a drug-discovery study.
method: Adapted coarse-to-fine diffeomorphic LapIRN with affine pre-registration and multimodal deformable registration.
Added test-time instance optimization and skeletal rigidity regularization.
Introduced MTV and TLG preservation losses with Jacobian-based constraints.
evidence_signal: For the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge submission, the authors report 81.0% DSC, 6.17 mm HD95, and 3.3% errors for both MTV and TLG under their evaluation protocol.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify evaluation sample size or external validation, leaving generalizability uncertain.
paper_title: PET Quantification-Preserving Registration for Longitudinal Whole-Body PSMA PET/CT
